# Shape N Shades

Shape N Shades is a luxury architecture and interior design firm based in Dadar East, Mumbai.

## Services Offered
- Architecture: Custom layout, blueprints, elevations, and structural planning.
- Interior Design: Turnkey residential and commercial design services.
- Landscape Design: Vastu-compliant green layouts and open spaces.
- Construction Administration: Supervision and execution support.
